# ATX Heading

A paragraph with _emphasis_, __strong__, ~~struck~~, `code`, and a [link](https://example.com).

Setext Heading
==============

* star bullet
* second item
    * nested item

1) first ordered
2) second ordered

> A quote with **bold**.
> Second line.

~~~rust
fn main() {
    println!("hi");
}
~~~

| Left | Right |
| :--- | ---: |
| one | two |

- [ ] task open
- [x] task done

<div class="note">
raw html
</div>

A footnote reference[^1] and a hard break  
after it.

[^1]: The footnote text.
